title: Pull, Bull, Pull!
lines: The bull is on the hill.
Tim has a bag full of figs.
The bull tugs at the bag.
The bull will not let up.
The figs fall in the mud!
The bull gets all the figs.

questions.listenFor: Figs. It is stated in the story - if they cannot find it, have them reread the third line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why do the figs fall in the mud?
questions.listenFor: Tim and the bull both pulled on the bag. You want cause and effect, not just "they fell."

questions.ask: Do you think Tim will bring figs up the hill again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason that comes from the story, like "no, the bull will take them."
